# Rhythm sample

The runner reads the ledger and then reports every gate it finds. The linter judges each oracle and then refuses the ones that cannot fail. The spec agent writes the ledger and then commits it with the round. The implementer runs the gates and then commits the evidence lines. The first verifier re-runs every gate and then writes its verdict. The second verifier reads the status and then judges the intent. The closeout agent pastes the evidence and then deletes the ledger. The orchestrator dispatches six lines and then waits for the return.
